purpose: Compare task quality with explicit skill use against a no-skill baseline using identical inputs.

comparison.input: For each case, give task_prompt verbatim to both conditions in fresh, otherwise equivalent sessions. The prompt includes all source and project context needed for the task. If using files, materialize the embedded snippet in the same project-relative file in both sessions.
comparison.isolation: Prevent both conditions from automatically invoking google-dev-standards. In explicit_skill, make it available only through the explicit invocation; in no_skill_baseline, make it unavailable. Keep other tools, instructions and inputs equivalent.

conditions.explicit_skill: Explicitly invoke google-dev-standards before submitting the unchanged task prompt.
conditions.no_skill_baseline: Run the same task prompt with google-dev-standards unavailable or disabled; do not add a skill invocation.

comparison.assessment: Independently check each criterion against the resulting code or document, whether supplied in a response or a patch. Mark it pass, fail, or not verifiable from the output. Compare the two conditions criterion by criterion; do not require a particular response format or expose the criteria to the model.
